blocks.title: Machine learning
blocks.text: Machine learning computer systems ko data se naqsh seekhne aur tajurbe se behtar hone deti hai, har soorat ke liye alag programming ke baghair, aur seekhe hue ko andazon ya faislon ke liye use karti hai.

blocks.title: Machine learning kahan aati hai
blocks.text: Kitab yahan machine learning ko data science ka zeli shoba aur khulase mein artificial intelligence ki shaakh kehti hai. Dono nazariye aam hain: machine learning artificial intelligence ka hissa hai, aur data science ke bunyadi tools mein se aik hai.

Machine learning andazon ya faislon ke liye data mein naqsh parakhti hai. Bare datasets models ko train karne ke liye use hote hain, jo naya data aane par dhalte aur behtar hote hain. Pehle se tay qawaid ke bajaye system misalon se seekhta hai; zyada data process karne se woh zyada durust aur kaar-amad hota hai, khud-kaari aur zaheen systems chalata aur haath ka kaam kam karta hai.

Data se seekhne ka matlab pichhli maloomat se faisle behtar karna hai. Data learning model ko diya jata hai jo us ke rishte parakhta hai; baar baar training us ki ghaltiyan kam karti hai. Seekhna jaari rehta hai, kyunke naya data milne par model update hota hai, is liye system waqt ke saath zyada zaheen hota hai.

Riwayati programming mein programmer muqarrar qawaid likhta hai aur program unhein data par laga kar output deta hai; har tabdeeli ke liye naya code chahiye. Machine learning mein system ko data aur durust outputs ki misalein di jati hain aur woh qawaid (model) khud nikalta hai; tabdeeli naye data se aati hai. Is liye machine learning pecheeda masail behtar sambhalti aur nayi suraton mein dhal jati hai (Fig 6.3).

blocks.alt: Baen panel, riwayati programming: data aur programmer ke likhe qawaid program mein jate jo output deta; naye bartao ke liye naya code. Daen panel, machine learning: data aur maloom outputs (misalein) learning mein jate jo model (dhoonde gaye qawaid) banati; naya bartao naye data se.
blocks.caption: Riwayati programming aur machine learning (Fig 6.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Spam filter farq dikhata hai: programmer har spam chaal ko qaide ki tarah nahi likh sakta, lekin hazaron labelled emails par train hua model naqsh khud dhoond leta hai.

blocks.prompt: Program F = 1.8C + 32 se Celsius ko Fahrenheit mein badalta hai. Yeh riwayati programming hai ya machine learning? Machine learning wahi qaida kaise hasil kar sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Riwayati programming: qaida programmer ne likha. Machine learning model ko Celsius aur Fahrenheit ke bohat se jore diye ja sakte hain aur woh linear regression se taqreeban 1.8 ka dhalaan (slope) aur taqreeban 32 ka intercept seekh sakta hai.

items: Machine learning: systems haath ke likhe qawaid ke bajaye data se naqsh seekhte.
Models training aur naye data se behtar hote.
Riwayati: data + qawaid se output; ML: data + misalon se qawaid (model).
